verified_facts: DOE/NLR Geologic Enhanced Mapping System (GEMS) Prize Official Rules, September 2026, governed by 15 U.S.C. section 3719.
Total prize pool $300,000: Phase 1 $50,000 split equally ($10,000 x 5) on withheld private test set; Phase 2 $250,000 ($100k / $70k / $40k / $25k / $15k) on expert-updated full label set.

Single 100 m GeoTIFF prediction raster over the GeoDAWN study area; up to 3 weekly submissions for automated public-leaderboard feedback; exactly ONE final submission selected for both Phase 1 and Phase 2 judging without knowing private-test scores.
Finalists must submit reproducible code/documentation and disclose any generative-AI assistance in the technical narrative.

Cites GeoDAWN (https://doi.org/10.5066/P93LGLVQ, Glen & Earney 2024), USGS 1-m DEM features, and INGENIOUS (https://doi.org/10.15121/1881483, Ayling et al. 2022) + USGS Qfaults / NLR-USGS expert fault labels.
Great Basin Center for Geothermal Energy (UNR) INGENIOUS project page (DOE GTO award DE-EE0009254, $10M, 2021-2025, PIs Ayling & Faulds).

Links official Great Basin datasets: regional dataset compilation (10.15121/1881483), heat flow (10.5066/P9BZPVUC), regional gravity/magnetics (10.5066/P9Z6SA1Z), MT electrical conductance (10.5066/P9TWT2LU), Quaternary fault slip/dilation tendency (10.5066/P9YL58W6), and crustal strain rates (10.1785/0220220153).
DOE Geothermal Data Repository submission 1391: INGENIOUS - Great Basin Regional Dataset Compilation (DOI 10.15121/1881483, CC-BY-4.0 attribution required, provided as-is).

Lists 9 downloadable archives (116.98 MB total, including 2m_temperature_probe, seismicity, geodetics, paleo_geothermal, qfaults_ingenious_nad83conus117_2023-06-27.zip, great_basin_q_volcanics.zip, wellspringdata.gdb.zip) and linked USGS DOIs (P9TWT2LU, P9MQRCBY, P9Z6SA1Z, P9BZPVUC, P9YL58W6).
Caveat: contains Quaternary fault compilations (qfaults_ingenious), which must never be used as input features due to direct label leakage.

Returned 504 Gateway Time-out during live recheck on 2026-10-24; 2026-10-23 verified excerpt remains recorded in source-review-20261023.json, and official GeoDAWN DOI https://doi.org/10.5066/P93LGLVQ was independently confirmed via docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96647.pdf.
EPSG:32611 = WGS 84 / UTM zone 11N, Transverse Mercator, central meridian -117 deg, scale factor 0.9996, false easting 500000 m, false northing 0 m, unit metre, bounds 120W to 114W.

Asymmetric Tversky similarity S(X,Y) = |X cap Y| / (|X cap Y| + alpha*|X \ Y| + beta*|Y \ X|) (Tversky 1977, 10.1037/0033-295x.84.4.327); alpha=0.2, beta=0.8 weights missed truth 4x more heavily than false positives.
